bio.en: Hi, I'm Xiaoming, a master's student at Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT). I study data visualization and human–computer interaction, and build tools for exploring datasets and connecting research notes. Previously, I studied Computer Science and Technology at MIT. Xiaoming, the educational history, projects, and achievements are fictional; MIT is used only as an example school name.
bio.zh: 你好，我是小明，目前在麻省理工学院（MIT）攻读硕士，研究方向为数据可视化与人机交互。我喜欢用简洁的工具探索数据、梳理研究笔记，本科也在 MIT 学习计算机科学与技术。小明及其就读经历、项目与成果均为虚构，仅以 MIT 作为学校名称示例。

interests.en: Data Visualization · Human–Computer Interaction · Research Tools
interests.zh: 数据可视化 · 人机交互 · 研究工具

title.zh: 文献花园的第一个原型

description.en: Connected reading notes with topic tags and an interactive graph in the first Note Garden prototype.
description.zh: 完成文献花园的第一个原型，用主题标签和交互式关系图连接阅读笔记。

title.en: Linking Reading Notes with Interactive Topic Maps for Literature Review
title.zh: 面向文献梳理的交互式主题地图与阅读笔记关联

description.en: A research prototype combining keyword tags, cross-paper links, and an interactive topic map to help students revisit questions across their reading notes.
description.zh: 结合关键词标签、跨论文关联和交互式主题地图，帮助学生在阅读笔记之间回顾问题、整理研究线索。

status.en: Demo manuscript · Not submitted or published
status.zh: 演示稿件 · 未投稿、未发表

description.en: Organizes paper summaries and research questions in a local notebook, with full-text search, topic tags, and a graph of cross-paper connections.
description.zh: 将论文摘要和研究问题整理为本地笔记，提供全文检索、主题标签和跨论文关联图。

description.en: Pairs scatterplots, heatmaps, and linked brushing to inspect small tabular datasets and compare visual encodings.
description.zh: 结合散点图、热力图和联动选择，探索小型表格数据，比较不同视觉编码的表达方式。

description.en: Turns study notes into concept maps and prerequisite paths, with checkpoints for reviewing learning progress.
description.zh: 把学习笔记组织成概念地图和先修路径，通过阶段检查点回顾学习进展。

description.en: Designed literature-note interfaces and interactive topic maps; prepared usability-study tasks and organized observation notes for prototype iteration.
description.zh: 设计文献笔记界面与交互式主题地图，编写可用性研究任务，并整理观察记录用于原型迭代。

title.en: Master's Studies in Visualization and Human–Computer Interaction
title.zh: 硕士 · 可视化与人机交互

description.en: Studies interactive visualization, research-note organization, and the design of accessible research tools.
description.zh: 关注交互式可视化、研究笔记组织，以及易用研究工具的设计。

title.en: Bachelor's Studies in Computer Science and Technology
title.zh: 本科 · 计算机科学与技术

description.en: Studied programming, data structures, and software engineering, with course projects in visualization and learning tools.
description.zh: 学习程序设计、数据结构与软件工程，并围绕可视化和学习工具完成课程项目。

title.zh: 学生研究项目展示奖（演示）

description.en: Presented a literature-note prototype connecting paper summaries, research questions, and topic maps.
description.zh: 设计并展示文献笔记原型，关联论文摘要、研究问题与主题地图。

contact.en: I welcome conversations about visualization, human–computer interaction, and useful research tools. Feel free to reach out if you would like to exchange ideas or explore a collaboration.
contact.zh: 欢迎交流数据可视化、人机交互和研究工具，也期待与有共同兴趣的伙伴讨论合作。欢迎来信分享想法，一起探索有趣的问题。
